verdict.rationale: Gusto exposes webhooks (e.g., payroll.paid) that notify external systems when events occur, which could be used as the trigger half of an automation, but there is no evidence of a native rules engine where a user can define conditional logic/actions within Gusto itself — automation logic must be built entirely on the partner's side. Missing for 10: no in-product rule builder, no conditional action configuration UI, no evidence of if-this-then-that style automation within Gusto.
